stem: Which nerve is most commonly injured in winged scapula?
explanation: Long thoracic nerve (C5-C7) innervates serratus anterior. Injury causes medial scapular border prominence (winged scapula). Axillary nerve injury causes deltoid weakness. Suprascapular affects supraspinatus/infraspinatus.

stem: Which ECG finding is characteristic of atrial fibrillation?
explanation: Atrial fibrillation shows irregularly irregular RR intervals with absent distinct P waves. Regular RR suggests sinus or other regular rhythm.
